title: BANT Lead Qualification Schema
description: Structured contract for scoring an inbound lead against Budget, Authority, Need, and Timeline before routing it to a sales rep or a nurture sequence.

budget_confirmed.description: Whether the lead has explicitly confirmed allocated budget for this category, either in a form field, discovery-call transcript, or enrichment data. Do not infer this from company size alone.

budget_range_usd.description: Optional. [min, max] monthly or one-time budget range in USD, if disclosed. Omit entirely rather than guessing a range.

authority_level.description: Decision-making power of the contact within their org, as stated or reasonably inferred from their title/role in the form or enrichment data.

need_severity.description: Self-reported or inferred urgency of the problem being solved. 1 = exploring options with no active pain; 10 = actively losing revenue/customers today because of this problem.

timeline_days.description: Number of days until the lead expects to make a decision or start implementation. Use a conservative estimate (round up) when the lead gives a vague answer like 'this quarter.'

points.description: OUTPUT field. Transparent point total (0-12) the reference scorer used to derive tier — kept in the output so you can audit/recalibrate thresholds later, not just trust a black-box label.

tier.description: OUTPUT field. Computed tier used for routing — do not set this manually; it should be derived by the scoring function below.

recommended_action.description: OUTPUT field. Recommended next action, derived from tier.
